text: Swimming is a low-impact exercise that works all major muscle groups, making it an excellent way to stay fit and healthy. The technique of swimming typically involves a sequence of movements, starting with a powerful kick that propels you through the water. Once you're moving, you use your arms to propel yourself forward, starting with a small, controlled stroke and gradually increasing the speed and power as you build momentum. This sequence allows you to maintain a steady pace while conserving energy and reducing the risk of injury. By focusing on proper breathing and kicking techniques from the start, you can set yourself up for a successful and enjoyable swim.
